compiled_state.title: As a CI llm-review runner, story-branch deltas exceeding 400 LOC or 15 files trigger region-split FALLBACK with parallel reviewers, deduplicated findings, and opus arch synthesis
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Strategy E region-split FALLBACK in CI llm-review pipeline. When a story-branch delta exceeds 400 LOC or 15 files, the existing HUGE-diff FALLBACK path is replaced: file-clustered regions reviewed in parallel by tier-appropriate reviewers; findings deduplicated on (file, line-range, dimension, claim-fingerprint) with line-range overlap matching (not exact-match); conflicting severities resolved to MAX; both rationales preserved as a merged-rationale field when severities differ (no silent rationale discard); opus arch synthesis pass for boundary-only issues that cross region clusters.
**Why**: Closes the gap where the current FALLBACK passes the whole oversized diff to a single reviewer agent.

**Scope**:
- IN: Heuristic file-clustering algorithm (directory + topic clustering or fixed byte-budget per region with file-boundary alignment)
- IN: Parallel reviewer dispatch (reuse existing tier-appropriate reviewer agents)
- IN: Dedup library: keys on (file, line-range, dimension, claim-fingerprint) with line-range overlap matching
- IN: MAX-severity reconciliation rule with dual-rationale merge
- IN: Opus arch synthesis pass that sees all region findings + full diff stat to surface boundary-only issues
- OUT: Sub-400 LOC review path (unchanged from S8)
- OUT: Reviewer agent definitions themselves — coordinate with 4911-c7ba

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, a push to a story/<id> with delta > 400 LOC or 15 files triggers the region-split path; CI workflow log shows file-cluster partition and parallel reviewer dispatches
  ← Satisfies: "SC5: region-split FALLBACK"
- When this story is complete, seeded fixture with overlapping region findings asserts dedup with MAX-severity reconciliation and dual-rationale preservation in the merged-rationale field
  ← Satisfies: "SC5: line-range-overlap dedup + MAX-severity + dual-rationale"
- When this story is complete, opus arch synthesis pass produces at least one boundary-only finding on a fixture where a logic error spans two region clusters
  ← Satisfies: "SC5: opus arch synthesis for boundary-only issues"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Coordinate with 4911-c7ba (reviewer rubric expansion) — reviewer agent interface must reach stable contract before this story wires the parallel dispatch.
- [Reliability] File-clustering heuristic must produce balanced clusters; document the chosen algorithm and add fixture tests for skew-resistance.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
